entities.summary: Ricardo Duarte Mungi is a Peruvian former professional basketball player. Standing at 2.09 m tall, Duarte played at the center position. While representing the Peruvian national team, Duarte was the FIBA World Cup Top Scorer in 1963, as well as the FIBA Summer Olympics Top Scorer in 1964. He was named one of FIBA's 50 Greatest Players, in 1991.
